svg.desc: Two panels on word of mouth up to a scheduled announcement, in a model where 1% of a homogeneously mixing population hears at time 0 and each person who hears tells on average 2 others, only within her own spreading time, whose mean is the unit of time. Top, the share who have heard against time from 0 to 12, for an exponential spreading time, a solid line, and for a top hat between 0.8 and 1.2, a dashed line. At the announcement at time 5, marked by a vertical line, 0.588 and 0.325 have heard; both approach 0.800 in the end, marked by a horizontal line. Bottom, the share newly hearing per unit of time: the exponential case rises to a single peak of 0.182 at about time 3.6, and the top hat comes in waves, the highest 0.223 at about time 5.0.
